title: Rook Lifts and Batteries
description: Rooks are not just for open files. Learn to lift rooks into the attack along the third rank and to build powerful batteries.

sections.title: The Rook Lift
sections.content: A rook lift (e.g. Re1-e3-g3/h3) swings a rook in front of its pawns to join a kingside attack. It is often the move that brings the decisive extra attacker.

positions.commentary: White prepares a kingside attack with a rook lift Rf1-f3-g3/h3, adding a heavy piece to the assault.
The rook is ready to swing to g3 or h3, joining the queen and bishop in a direct attack on the black king.

sections.title: Building a Battery
sections.content: A battery lines up two pieces on the same file or diagonal — queen behind rook on a file, or bishop behind queen on a diagonal — multiplying their power against a single target.

positions.commentary: White doubles queen and rook on the d-file, a battery that overloads the defense of the back rank and the d-file.
hints: Build a battery on the open file

exercises.title: Form the Battery
exercises.description: White to play. Combine the queen with the rook on the open d-file.
hints: Stack heavy pieces on the file
